description:
## 1.12.0-tairiku.3-rc.1 (experimental, 2026-10-12)

* Add opt-in **Fix external post links** to open externally shared X status URLs directly in post detail, bypassing the Home/For You route.
* Keep **Hide Find more** and **Hide Who to follow** selectable; refine Find more targeting to related posts only.
* Verified static APK patching and fingerprint uniqueness on X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01.
* **UNVERIFIED on device.** This is an experimental opt-in build; preserve the stable release if needed.
